kpis.description_fr: 2,8 M passagers transportés 2024 (Norwegian Cruise Line + Oceania + Regent Seven Seas). Reprise post-COVID achevée.
kpis.description_en: 2.8M passengers carried in 2024 (Norwegian Cruise Line + Oceania + Regent Seven Seas). Post-COVID recovery completed.

kpis.description_fr: Load Factor ~105 % (cabines double-occupées). Pricing power post-COVID. Industrie cruise running near full capacity.
kpis.description_en: Load Factor ~105% (double-occupied cabins). Post-COVID pricing power. Cruise industry running near full capacity.

kpis.description_fr: Net Yield = revenu net /passager /jour. Mesure pricing power cruise. Reprise + 8 % 2024 confirme demand persistence.
kpis.description_en: Net Yield = net revenue per passenger per day. Cruise pricing power metric. +8% 2024 confirms demand persistence.

kpis.description_fr: 33 navires : 19 Norwegian + 8 Oceania + 6 Regent Seven Seas. Croissance modérée (1-2 newbuilds /an). Pipeline 13 ordres firme 2026-2036.
kpis.description_en: 33 vessels: 19 Norwegian + 8 Oceania + 6 Regent Seven Seas. Moderate growth (1-2 newbuilds/year). Firm pipeline of 13 orders 2026-2036.

kpis.description_fr: Advance Ticket Sales = bookings pré-payés futurs. KPI demand forward 12-18 mois. Record élevé = visibilité forte.
kpis.description_en: Advance Ticket Sales = pre-paid future bookings. Forward demand KPI 12-18 months. Record high = strong visibility.
